editorial:
Imagine having a secret power that lets you see things others can't, but instead of fighting crime, you just use it to get by at your office job. That is exactly where you start with this story. You follow a guy who has these strange paranormal gifts and works at a firm where things seem normal on the surface. However, he quickly figures out that one of his coworkers is stealing from the company. The vibe starts off like a slow office drama, but once he tries to call out the cheating colleague, the movie shifts into a dangerous game of cat and mouse. It feels like a throwback to those early 90s thrillers where you never know who to trust.

You will probably notice that the acting is solid for an indie film, and the way the tension builds keeps you glued to your seat. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff makes it worth your time. If you are into stories about psychic powers and corporate greed, you should definitely check this out. Since it is an older flick, you might want to look for a high-quality digital version.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the tension peaks as the colleague tries to silence the main character for good. After a series of scary confrontations, the man uses his paranormal abilities to outsmart his enemy. He manages to expose the theft and the evil plans of his coworker, leading to a final showdown where the bad guy gets what he deserves. The movie wraps up with the truth coming out and the main character finally finding some peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 90s supernatural thrillers and corporate mysteries.
